# Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

# Validation

List the commands, notebooks, or manual checks used to validate the change.

# Artifact Impact

State whether this changes datasets, checkpoints, generated outputs, or notebook result files.

# Checklist

- [ ] Tests or validation steps are documented.
- [ ] No raw datasets, generated outputs, or credentials are committed.
- [ ] Notebook files are in the correct folder.
- [ ] README or folder docs are updated when paths change.
